summary: Encoder corrupts promoted fields of structs embedded three or more levels deep (shared backing array of the field-index path is overwritten by append).

provenance.note: Evaluator-only. base_sha is the parent of the upstream fix; the fix is never reachable from the sealed clone.
provenance.reference_patch: git diff --binary 702f5a6..75a4f17 (encode.go fix plus the upstream regression case, unchanged)
provenance.difficulty_note: The symptom (repeated keys) is far from the cause: eStruct builds per-field index paths with append on a slice that shares its backing array across siblings; upstream only copied it on 32-bit platforms. The upstream author's own commit message says the cause was not fully understood.
provenance.size_note: about 5.9k non-test Go lines at base

reference.note: Evaluator-only. The verifier renders the reference patch from upstream: git diff --binary -M base_sha commit -- paths, per step.
